text:
tara: starting a short thread to align on recurring-incident remediation ownership + how well validate fixes. covering OctDec rollup.
carl: +1. product wants clear customer-impact metrics and a verification plan before we close epics.
priya: from the rollup heatmap the top buckets are: cache eviction spikes, model OOMs on long sessions, and replica lag. I uploaded the heatmap: https://redwood.internal/ops/heatmaps/recurring_q4.png
dan: note: model OOMs often co-occur with user sessions >50k tokens. we should include synthetic long-session tests in validation.
lisa: can support (me + tara) collect a small sample of impacted customer request-ids so we can replay exact prompts? that would make repros meaningful.
josh: eng-sre: I'll add SLO smoke tests to CI (30-min job) and a synthetic runner that replays heavy-chat traces against Dedicated and Hosted.
incident-bot: compiled 39 incidents with recurring tags (2025-10-01..2025-12-31). summary CSV attached to the doc.
tara: proposed owners + proof-of-fix criteria:
- cache evictions -> @priya. proof: per-route eviction rate <3% for 30d under production traffic + synthetic replay. ticket CHORE-504. ETA 2026-02-20.
- model OOMs -> @dan. proof: 7-day long-session stress-run with 0 OOMs on dedicated pool + deploy pin with fallback behavior. ticket CHORE-507. ETA 2026-02-15.
- replica lag -> @josh. proof: replica lag <200ms p95 during 2 perf windows + automated failover drill executed. ticket CHORE-511. ETA 2026-02-25.
carl: product action: we will prioritize customer-facing rollouts for any change that affects latency. PMs will sign-off on verification artifacts before closure.
priya: adding observability items: per-tenant eviction metric, eviction-alert for >3%/10m, and dashboard tiles for regression detection.
dan: also adding a short-term guardrail: session token soft-limit at 75k with a customer-visible warning and a monitored opt-out for research clusters.
lisa: support will compile impacted customer list and notify SEs if replays might affect privacy; well coordinate masked traces.
josh: will schedule a canary window and a failover drill for replica changes; will also add runbook entries for manual rollback.
tara: timeline check: everyone comfortable with ETAs?
priya: yes.
dan: yes.
josh: yes.
carl: set a KPI: 60% reduction in recurring incidents (heatmap-weighted) by end of Q1 vs Q4 baseline. weekly measurement.
incident-bot: follow-up reminder set for 2026-03-01 09:00 PST to review validation artifacts and metrics.
tara: thanks all. Ill post the action-item table in the tracker and ping owners to add final ticket links by EOD Wednesday. close thread after that.
